_comment: Dish tags. The app shows them on dishes and makes one filter chip per tag with a 'filter'. mode 'exclude' hides dishes with the tag (No spice), 'include' keeps only dishes with it (Vegetarian). 'hint' tells Gemini when the tag applies. Add a tag here and the next build asks Gemini to tag every dish for it once; answers are saved in auto-tags.json.

tags.hint: the usual recipe has no meat, poultry or seafood; fish sauce or shrimp paste counts as seafood
served in broth, or is a soup, stew or hot pot
noodles are the main starch: rice noodles, wheat noodles, glass noodles or pasta
